description: Makeover arc part 1/2: Jason and Lucia go 'orang kaya baru', pick couple outfits in red and black, then chat turns into a GPS to find a barber ('arah jam 6!'). Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-makeoverarc1/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-makeoverarc1.mp4): 10 pieces (0.6 s padding each) of windah-live11/stream-2126-2226.mp4 (h3) and stream-2226-2326.mp4 (h4) in output order, 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: T t 1440.50-1441.70 = local 0.60-1.80 -> output 0.00-1.20; A t 1245.60-1250.60 = local 3.00-8.00 -> output 1.20-6.20; B t 1288.50-1297.30 = local 9.20-18.00 -> output 6.20-15.00; C t 1308.60-1311.90 = local 19.20-22.50 -> output 15.00-18.30; D t 1324.90-1326.40 = local 23.70-25.20 -> output 18.30-19.80; E t 1327.40-1333.10 = local 26.40-32.10 -> output 19.80-25.50; F t 1363.00-1370.30 = local 33.30-40.60 -> output 25.50-32.80; G t 1374.10-1376.30 = local 41.80-44.00 -> output 32.80-35.00; H t 1379.00-1383.00 = local 45.20-49.20 -> output 35.00-39.00; I t 1388.30-1390.30 = local 50.40-52.40 -> output 39.00-41.00. Beats in stream order: frame-0 teaser (h4 24:00.5, the finished couple look); 'orang kaya baru' into the fancy store (h3 20:45); red or black for the couple outfit (h3 21:28-21:37); 'ada merahnya ada hitamnya' (h3 21:48); 'Lucianya cantik banget' over the couple walking (h3 22:05); the barber hunt on the map, 'gambar gunting' (h3 22:07-22:13); chat as GPS 'arah jam 6' / 'arah jam 5' (h3 22:43-23:03); cliffhanger 'gambar apa sih itu? gunting' (h3 23:08). Word timings from faster-whisper medium on short windows. CUT: every spoken 'polo' (clothing brand, h3 21:20, 21:26, 22:35), a TV lawyer's name (h3 22:27), 'tato' (22:58.7), the film-title line at h3 19:51 and the swear at h3 20:16. The store's sign and item labels are the game's own fictional brand. Jason's tee in cut A has a small car print. No guns, gore or revealing outfits in frame. Main 41.00 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1504x846 at (0,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 352x264 at (1568,516) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'ORANG KAYA BARU', line 2 Volt 'MAKEOVER DIMULAI', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
